audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 with 48.91% WR over 1188 games: she owns pre-6 range, he owns 6 all-ins and item spikes — matches the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart disagreed with content/packet on all seven rows' framing: blanket Skill 0-3 vs Taliyah, Yone at level 6 vs Taliyah, Skill at first item vs Yone, Yone at 2+ vs Taliyah. Content whys[5] also described level 6 while sitting on the first-item row, and spikes[2] argued Taliyah wins first item while win[5] says Yone.
audit.why: Content and packet agree everywhere; kits support them (no waveclear/sustain early, first crit item + dash resets is his spike, her cross-map R and anti-dash W dictate late).
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content; whys[5] rewritten to first-item framing; spikes[2].text rewritten to match the Yone-favored verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interaction: Spirit Cleave's shield (14s cooldown, scales with attack speed) absorbs her burst opener — never stated. Both his Q3 and R count as dashes her W/E punish, stated in content but absent from full-layer dos bullets. dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second' Soul Unbound window; the real cooldown is 22-10s.
audit.why: Kit: W 'grants a shield', cd 14, 'cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed'; E cd 22/19/16/13/10.
audit.corrected: Shield-strip added to report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns; dash-detonation written into dosFull[1].d; 22-second number fixed.
Soul Unbound 22/10s, his W 14s, her W 14s stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed in dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d; unsourced 'TP doubles' magnitude in report[7].t; 'meleerange' typo in whys[1].
audit.why: Lint findings plus one visible typo.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Yone has no waveclear and no sustain at level 1 — every last-hit costs him a Q rock to the face from your 1000 range.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: shove him back mid-Q3 wind-up — his 450-range melee kit cannot answer your poke yet.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: if he commits Q3 or Soul Unbound, drop E under him and W him back — the dash detonates your mines.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — keep zoning his farm; spaced well, your W-E peel beats his pre-6 all-in attempts.

edits.before: Yone
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: You still edge farm and poke at 6, but Fate Sealed makes his all-in real — hold W or Flash for the R engage.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Yone

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: His first crit item spike: dash resets on your wave close past poke — freeze or shove-and-back, keep W up.

edits.before: Yone
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Post-spike you swing back: waveclear, cross-map R and W anti-dash peel dictate the map against a telegraphed diver.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Check it before every step-up. - W Seismic Shove is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1, 10 at max — survive the spirit window and punish the body he snaps back to. - His W shield cycles every 14s minus attack speed: strip it before you burst. - Your 14s W is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: His Q3 and Soul Unbound both count as dashes through your minefield — W him backward mid-dash and the gap-close whiffs into a stun.

edits.before: Yone burns Soul Unbound on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Yone burns Soul Unbound on nothing — take the 22-second invitation.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: Once the mines expire his dashes are free — extended trades feed his double-hit passive and his 14s W shield cycle.

edits.before: Track Yone’s Soul Unbound: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is his burst window — survive it, then punish the body he snaps back to. Force his W shield out before you commit.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan cross-map; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.

edits.before: At 2 your Q double-cast still outranges and outpokes his meleerange, keeping you ahead.
edits.after: At 2 your Q double-cast still outranges and outpokes his melee range, keeping you ahead.

edits.before: Level 6 tips to Yone: Fate Sealed lets him flash-knockup you from range and burst before you can W-kite.
edits.after: First item tips to Yone: crit plus Q3 dash resets close past your poke before your own spike answers.

edits.before: With Lost Chapter into Blackfire/Liandry's your rotation out-trades his early bruiser build; his damage spikes later on crit than yours does on AP. Keep W ready as your peel button and E-detonate to interrupt his dash-in, and your combo bursts him before his Q3 resets.
edits.after: First item is his window: crit plus Q3 dash resets on your wave let him close past your poke, and his W shield eats your opening rock. Respect it — freeze or shove-and-back, keep W as your peel button, and E-detonate his dash-in rather than trading straight.

notes: Content whys[5] described level 6 on the first-item row and spikes[2] argued the opposite verdict from win[5] — both rewritten to the Yone-favored first-item reading that packet and win[5] share. Full row 4 (level 6) moved Yone→Taliyah to agree with content+packet; the kit supports either reading (his R spike vs her farm/poke edge), so I followed the two agreeing sources and kept the danger explicit in the why. Yone's E cooldown drops 22→10s with ranks — the dosFull[2].d number uses rank 1.
